name: paved
description: Direct task work and project context for coding agents, with declared Tools, verification, evidence, optional governed workflows and a pinned project-local runtime.

interface.longDescription: Paved defaults to direct, outcome-focused work: the agent uses repository context and rules, runs applicable checks, and reports what it verified. Use governed intent, plan and execute workflows only when requested or required by project policy. A pinned project-local runtime provides CLI commands, declared Tools, verification and evidence. The local Workbench follows runs and recent Claude Code or Codex activity.
defaultPrompt: Show the Paved status of this repository
Follow Paved work in the local dashboard
